product_metadata.title: Cuisinart TOB-40FR Custom Classic Toaster Oven Broiler, Silver (Renewed)
features: 1800 Watts to toast, bagel, bake and broil; full size interior holds 11-inch pizza and 6 slices of toast
Stainless steel front with rubberized easy grip dials, cool touch handle, and a front removable tray; easy clean nonstick interior, unit measures: 17" x 11.74" x 8.35"
Always even shade control monitors the temperature and adjusts timing to consistently toast to the shade selected every time
Convenient auto side-out rack for hands free loading and easy removal of cooked foods and automatic shutoff safety feature
This Certified Refurbished product is tested & certified by Cuisinart to look and work like-new. The product includes all original accessories, and is backed by a 90 day warranty
description: Cuisinart's TOB-40 toaster oven broiler is large enough and smart enough to present a full range of menu options. Toast four bagel halves, bake an 11-inch pizza, or broil two big open-faced sandwiches. Always Even Shade Control monitors the temperature and adjusts the timing to consistently toast to the shade selected every time. A convenient auto slide-out rack provides hands-free loading and easy removal of cooked foods. When the cooking is done, its easy to clean with its reflective nonstick coating on the oven's interior that wipes clean in seconds, which enhances heat efficiency and ensures even toasting.
